metadata.title: Seedance Examples: AI Video Showcase & Prompt Ideas
metadata.description: Browse Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 example ideas, cinematic prompts, product concepts, social videos, and practical ways to evaluate an AI video result.

hero.title: Seedance Examples
hero.description: A Seedance showcase with Seedance cinematic examples, Seedance 2.0 examples, product films, social clips, character continuity, and reference-led workflows—organized as prompts you can actually test.
hero.tip: Availability, pricing, and supported settings can vary by provider, region, and plan.

introduce.title: Examples should explain the shot
introduce.description: A showcase is more useful when it states the prompt, references, model version, settings, and quality criteria. Use these examples as starting points, not guarantees of identical output.

items.title: Cinematic scenes
items.description: Direct a single subject through a clear camera path, with timing, lighting, and an ending pose.

items.title: Product videos
items.description: Show materials, details, interaction, reflections, and a clean commercial composition.

items.title: Social formats
items.description: Design a hook, action, framing, and end beat for 9:16 or another target platform.

items.title: Reference workflows
items.description: Use images, video, or audio to anchor identity, motion, style, or scene continuity.

benefits.title: Seedance example ideas by use case
benefits.description: Match the example to a measurable result so you can improve the prompt without relying on vague “cinematic” wording.

items.title: Story and previsualization
items.description: Test blocking, camera movement, scene transitions, and narrative timing before a production shoot.

items.title: Advertising and ecommerce
items.description: Prototype product motion, UGC-style scenes, visual hooks, and alternate aspect ratios with authorized material.

items.title: Music and atmosphere
items.description: Coordinate motion, color, rhythm, ambience, and audio direction while checking synchronization.

items.title: Education and explainers
items.description: Turn a process or abstract idea into a short visual demonstration with readable composition and safe references.

features.title: Prompt patterns for Seedance examples
features.description: Use one pattern at a time, including Seedance 2.0 positive constraint examples when useful, then verify the actual output dimensions, motion, text, sound, and rights.

items.title: One-take narrative
items.description: A continuous [camera movement] follows [subject] as [action] unfolds from [time] to [time], ending with [final pose].

items.title: Product close-up
items.description: [Product] on [surface], [interaction] reveals [detail], [lighting] creates [reflection], [lens feel], [aspect ratio], no extra text.

items.title: Character continuity
items.description: Keep [identity anchors] unchanged while [subject] performs [small action]; preserve wardrobe, proportions, lighting, and location.

items.title: Reference direction
items.description: Use @Image 1 for [identity], @Video 1 for [motion], and @Audio 1 for [sound]; preserve [invariants], change [target edit].

items.title: UGC short
items.description: [Person] speaks to camera in [setting], opens with [hook], demonstrates [product], and ends with [natural call to action], 9:16.

items.title: Quality review
items.description: Compare the result to the brief at the beginning, middle, and end; log any drift, flicker, unreadable text, or audio mismatch.

faq.title: Seedance Examples FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: Where can I find a Seedance showcase or Seedance 2.0 AI video examples?
items.answer: Use official ByteDance Seed showcases and the provider interface where you plan to generate. Third-party demo reels may use different models, prompts, edits, or post-processing.

items.question: Can I generate a Seedance 2.0 example here?
items.answer: Yes, the current browser generator supports Seedance 2.0 workflows. Start with a short prompt or reference and review the credit estimate before submission.

items.question: Are Seedance 2.5 examples available?
items.answer: Official Seed pages publish Seedance 2.5 capability examples, while provider access varies. Use the 2.5 examples guide to plan a reproducible test.

items.question: Why do my Seedance examples look different?
items.answer: Generation is probabilistic and settings matter. Record the model, provider, input references, prompt, duration, resolution, and post-processing before comparing results.

items.question: Can Seedance create demo videos for an app?
items.answer: It can be evaluated for app concepts or product demonstrations, but use authorized UI, logos, people, and music and verify the final result before publishing.

cta.title: Create a documented Seedance example
cta.description: Pick one use case, write a complete shot brief, run a short test, and keep the prompt and output checks together.
